balls.text: misses the full delivery outside off, Mohit tries to sneak in a bye but DK, who had his right glove off, gets a direct hit
the yorker can't stay away from Starc for too long! Full, swinging in on the middle stump, Negi makes room to target the off side but the ball rams into the stumps
swings it way down the leg side for a wide and DK quickly throws it back to Starc

good, low catch by Wiese! Starc tried the yorker again, Bravo swiped the full toss on off but didn't middle it and it was chipped to cover where Wiese went forward and low to his left to get his hands under the ball
exposes all his stumps by going across all the way, and drives the low full toss from off stump to the midwicket region. They come back for two
full and wide way outside off, Bravo swings his bat and misses
pretty full on the off stump, Negi makes room and slashes that to cover. The fielder has a shy at bowler's end but misses
clears his front foot this time and drills the ball down to long off for one
this time it's a short ball, Negi goes back in the crease and slams that from the middle of the bat to the midwicket boundary with a pull. One-bounce four
113.4kph, makes room by moving towards leg, the ball doesn't have much pace and angles across as Negi swings and misses
holes out straight to long off! It was full just outside off, Dhoni hammered that straight down the ground and Starc went to his right to catch it safely
full and wide outside off, Dhoni swings and misses
heaves that from the off stump to the leg side, it's wide of deep square leg and they get two
dances down the ground to take it on the full and tonks that straight down the ground, hits the roof for a big six!
shorter and turning away, Dhoni tries to hammer it on the leg side and gets a bottom edge towards midwicket
turning away from outside off, pushed into the covers for one
that was not a sweep, not a slog, not a heave..it was a swipe against the turn from leg stump and he timed it so well it went for a big six over the cow corner

and he's back with a wicket! Jadeja opens up to heave the ball on the leg side. He doesn't get the distance and Kohli takes a couple of steps back at deep midwicket to catch it. Almost lost his balance
he heaves on the leg side now, it's being chased by AB from long on to his right. He gets a hand to it but it rolls away for four

full toss around off, Dhoni lofts it straight down to long off, he hasn't middled that at all. And a fumble by Sarfaraz at long off gives them a second. Starc raises his arms, Kohli stares at the fielder
full and angled in on the stumps, driven to midwicket for one more
slower offcutter outside off, Dhoni cuts it wide of point for one
nearly in the block hole on middle and leg, he can only defend it back to Starc
length delivery outside off, Jadeja gets an inside edge on the leg side for one
he comes down to smash it down the ground, only gets an outside edge and it goes just past the keeper fine on off. Dhoni hit it so hard the ball ran away for four
slower on middle and leg, he defends towards midwicket. Can't sneak in a single
turning into the batsman, tucked to deep midwicket for one
goes back and works the ball down to long on for one
charges down the track to take it on the full and hammers that over the bowler's head for a six nearly into the sight screen
fullish on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler

another wicket, the angle from round the wicket has done it as Harshal gets his second in the over! Raina stayed on the back foot and covered the stumps to steer the ball to leg with the angle, but missed it and was caught in front of middle stump
comes down and glides the low full toss a bit wide of third man, who runs to his left and slides to save two. That's the team's 100
full on the off stump now, pushed down towards mid on for an easy single
slightly slower on the off side, pushed into the covers gently
back of length outside off, Dhoni cuts that by turning his wrists to backward point
inside edge onto the stumps, Faf's gone! It was a slower one outside off, Faf went back and across in the crease to swipe it on the leg side but only edged it onto his off stump
length delivery on the stumps, turned down to long on with the wrists for one
wider outside off now, driven through the covers and that's his fifty
he loses his balance while whipping that over short fine leg but gets four! Went some way across the stumps for the ball on middle and cleared the fielder in the circle
slower one outside off, Faf runs it down to third man for one
comes down the track and drives that firmly to long on from leg stump
back of length and into the pads, helped to the leg side for one
outside off and turning away, cuts off the back foot to cover
high and handsome as he dances down and lofts that handsomely over the umpire's head with a straight bat. Long on cuts it to one
back of length towards middle and leg, turned off the back foot towards square leg
doesn't turn much outside off, Raina dabs it late towards short third man for one
full delivery on middle stump, pushed back to the bowler
turning into the batsman, Raina charges down to slog it on leg and bisects the gap between long on and deep midwicket for a six! Both fielders ran towards the ball but neither had a chance
fullish delivery on middle and leg is driven down to long on
full toss punched back, Faf dives to get in as the ball hits middle stump at the bowler's end. Looks like Kohli didn't get a hand to it
slower and fuller on off stump, turned down to long on for one more
fullish outside off, Raina drives it off the front foot to deep cover
Faf goes on the back foot and tucks the ball to midwicket

slow and in the block hole, Faf blocks on the leg side, Virat runs a fair bit towards midwicket, dives and throws to the keeper. But there was enough time for a single and they get a second for overthrows
just outside off with no room, Faf goes back and defends it to leg for one
comes down to take it on the full and drives it to long off for one
charges down to heave on the leg side now, it's much slower so it lands short and wide of deep midwicket
comes down the track and pushes the low full toss to Sarfaraz at point
presses forward on off and blocks the length ball
on middle with a bit of turn, pushes it off the back foot into the covers
slightly full outside off, driven off the back foot to point
slow and angling in towards off, Raina looks to tuck it to leg but is struck on the pad
another wide - this one is slow and short over Raina's head as he lets it go
no room at all as he angles it in towards off stump, Raina goes back and helps it to midwicket
slow and short well outside off, Raina lets it go for a wide
block hole around off, Faf goes across and blocks it on the leg side for one
fullish outside off and Raina drives that firmly to deep cover for one
slightly slow and back of length towards off, turned off the back foot to leg
towards the pads now, helped with the turn towards square leg
full again, closer to the stumps, and Raina slams the straight down the the ground over Faf's head towards long off for four more
full and wide outside off, Raina knows how to put those away - goes down on a knee and lofts that with an inside out drive over the covers for four
fullish outside off, pushed into the covers for one
makes room again and this time he slog-sweeps that big and long over deep midwicket for a massive six!
makes room and the bowler follows him on leg, tucked to leg against the turn
fuller and wider outside off, he drives it late and square to backward point. Mandeep dives to his right to get a hand to it and injures himself a bit as they come back for two
outside off now, driven to cover off the front foot
there was a loud noise as Raina pulled the ball down leg, DK appealed for caught behind and the umpire replies with a wide signal. Replays confirm it was the thigh pad
slightly back of length outside off and angling in, Raina defends off the back foot
quick and in the block hole outside off, Raina looks to tap it to third man and misses
pretty full and wide outside off, driven square to point
back of length outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover
pretty full on the pads, worked down to long on for one
fullish outside off, pushed down to long off for one
shorter and wider outside off, cuts off the back foot to deep cover
full on the pads, tucked to deep midwicket with the turn
pretty wide and full outside off, Raina leaves it for a wide
fullish on the pads, pushes it down to long on for one
low full toss outside off, driven down the ground for a single
bit of room outside off now, Raina guides it late to third man
offcutter outside the leg stump, Raina hops back and tucks to deep backward square leg for two
takes the pace off the ball, it's on the stumps and Raina defends it back

holes out to deep midwicket, Wiese gets Baz! This was a short ball and Baz didn't time it properly, it went in the air towards Abdulla, who was looking into the sun but caught that comfortably with both hands
very delicately played on the off side for four. There wasn't much room as the ball came in, he opened the face of the bat pretty late and beat short third man by guiding it fine
charges down the track, Wiese delivers a slow and short ball cutting away and Raina heaves on the leg side, only gets an inside edge past the stumps to short fine leg
drives that nicely through the covers off the front foot, to deep cover for one
slightly slow again and into the pads, worked to midwicket with the angle
slower one on the pads, Raina waits for it and works it behind square on the leg side for one
back of length towards the hips, Raina hops back and tucks it to short fine leg
stays back now and taps the ball towards point
Raina gets room outside off, he leans into the ball and drives that handsomely through the covers by getting on top of that. That was four the moment he hit it
short and wide outside off, slapped down straight to mid off
leans towards the ball and pushes it from length into the covers
this time he goes back and taps the wider ball late to third man for one
slower ball outside off as Wiese rolls his fingers over that one, Raina attempts to cut late but misses
fullish outside off now, driven into the covers off the front foot
fullish on middle stump, Raina puts his front foot forward and flicks that well over mid on for a powerful four
such timing, what placement! There was only a bit of room outside off, Baz waited in the crease and cut that with his wrists right in the gap between point and third man for four!
tries the yorker and it's a full toss on the pads. Baz doesn't use much power, only uses the pace of the ball by clipping that with good timing past mid on for four
comes out of his crease and drives the ball inside out over the covers, taking it on the full. Couldn't smash it from the middle of the bat as Maddinson ran from mid off to cut it off
leans forward this time and pushes the length ball to cover
bit back of length outside off, he stays back and defends to cover
angled towards middle stump, Raina goes across and helps it to fine leg
leading edge is chipped towards cover as the ball turns away, off the front foot
bit full outside off and there's enough room for Baz to free his arms and loft this over the covers and in the gap for four
bit slower on middle and leg now, Baz waits and drives it down to mid on
turning away a little bit from length outside off, pushed to point
full on the pads, helped with the turn down to long on for one
fullish on the off stump, driven down to long off for one

Starc struck! What a ball, what an over from Starc - he beats Smith completely by targeting the stumps this time, it didn't really swing as it pitched on middle and off to go straight, Smith was never in control of this one as he looked to steer this to leg, Off stump uprooted!
still full and much wider outside off, Smith doesn't move his feet at all and drives away from the body. Misses it third time in a row
beats him again, super yorker again! Right outside the off stump and angling away, Smith tries to block but misses it by a couple of inches
in the block hole outside off, Smith pokes and misses again
wider outside the off stump and angling away, left by Smith this time
swing and a miss first ball as it's pitched outside off with the angle and he chases but doesn't connect
it's all over, Abdulla cuts that slower ball from outside off to backward point. There was a bit of room, Abdulla swung his bat outside off and Negi took a low catch coming forward to seal the win
charges down the track and misses the back of length delivery outside off
some pace on that one, 129kph, and Harshal swings and misses on the off side

one more for CSK, Wiese caught at deep backward square leg! Slow and short offcutter coming into the batsman, Wiese heaves on the leg side and finds the fielder behind square. Bravo celebrates with a jig

120.8kph, good catch by Raina at long-on, running to his left! It was another slower one, on the leg side and Starc lofted that very high, trying a six over long on. But he didn't middle that and Raina got under it nicely to take it with both hands
slow offcutter from good length beats Starc's heave outside the off stump
fullish outside off, Wiese drives it late towards deep point for one
full offcutter outside off, Starc drills that down the ground to long off but can't come back for the second
full and swinging in on off, driven down to long off for one
Wiese starts well by slashing at that short and wide ball outside off and goes wide of point to find four behind square!
on length outside off without any pace, Starc bottom-edges it to the keeper and there's no time for a run
another slower one outside off, no pace at all and Starc misses again
that slower ball outside off hardly bounces as Starc heaves on the leg side but misses it by a long way
slow and full outside off, Starc swings his bat to drive that but misses
inner edge past the stumps to short fine leg, the fielder targets the stumps at keeper's end but misses and Starc makes it
slower ball cutting in, Wiese uses the angle and swivels his bat to find the fine leg boundary with a thick inner edge

it's Nehra again, he's got one more in this over! It was a yorker outside off, Harshal poked at it by opening the face of the bat towards point and edged it behind. Dhoni appeals, so does Nehra and the umpire raises his finger. Harshal looks unhappy, though, because there was no edge and the sound was of the bat hitting the ground
in the block hole outside off, pushed towards cover for a single

easily taken at fine leg, that went straight to him! Nehra angled the ball in, it wasn't that quick, and Sarfaraz swiped it high to the leg side, but it didn't go a long way and Smith hardly moved to catch that one
full on off now, aiming for the yorker, it's drilled straight to Baz
short ball angled in sharply as Sarfaraz makes room, he tries to scoop and ramp, but misses
in the block hole now on middle, Wiese digs it out past cover for one
Wiese goes a long way to off to ramp it to leg, Nehra delivers it close to him, just beating him outside off but the umpire calls it a wide
nearly caught by Bravo! Wiese drove the low full toss down to long off uppishly and Bravo stuck his left hand out to get fingers to it but it went past him
some room outside off and it's driven a bit wide of point for a quick single
pushes the slower ball between point and short third man. McCullum goes to his left and deflects the ball a bit wide of short third man, they come back for two
too full outside off and Sarfaraz cleverly slices it over and wide of point, taking one hand off the bat, for four!
he makes room, Bravo takes the pace off the ball and Sarfaraz chips the ball uppishly to cover
full delivery on off, driven down firmly to long off for one
full delivery on off stump, pushed down to long off for one
touch back of length outside off, Wiese taps it to point
tries to ramp it first ball to leg, but the ball goes across and takes the outside edge wide of Dhoni to third man as he took his eyes off the ball
slightly slower on leg stump, pushed down to long on for one
angled across outside off, Wiese cuts it to point

two in two for CSK, the crowd is on its feet, flags are waving, throats are aching! Short ball angling in and DK stayed back to middle that pull straight to deep midwicket. Smith hardly moves and takes it around his waist. Nehra laughs because he knows it wasn't a great delivery

such excellent work from Bravo, Kohli is run out! Kohli blocked the yorker back to Bravo and was well out of the crease. He didn't go back immediately even though Bravo stopped it with his right hand, Bravo threw the ball back in no time, rattled the stumps and Kohli's slide back wasn't enough
charges down again, Bravo delivers a slower ball and Kohli chips that uppishly to deep square leg to come back for the second
comes down and swipes the incoming delivery on the leg side to find midwicket
appeal for lbw as this one is angled into the pads, ball deflects off the pads to the off side. It was going down leg
full outside off, pushed down the ground with a straight bat
offcutter on the off side, pushed into the covers for a single and a powerful throw from McCullum, who was at cover, nearly hits Kohli as his bat got stuck just before the crease
slightly outside off, pushed down to long on off the back foot
full and slightly wide, Kohli drives that firmly past cover and in the gap between long off and deep cover for two
pretty wide outside off, Kohli slams that to deep point
he wants to run that fine on the off side but misses the ball
touch back of length outside off, DK punches that to deep cover
gets a low full toss and Kohli drives that firmly down to long off
goes wide of the crease to spear in a fuller one, Kohli works it to long-on
moves away from the stumps and dabs a flighted delivery from outside leg into the extra cover region. The man in the deep rushes in, but Kohli and DK are quicker

down the track and slaps the length ball to long-on! He had to reach out to it with Jaddu adjusting his line. Hurt his timing a bit and du Plessis hares after it from long-off, moving to his right like lightning and pulls in a big dive. The ball just bounces short of him
turned to short midwicket
whipped through the leg side, Kohli calls for two and has it despite Kartik losing his bat midway and running to the danger end
clears long-on! Didn't quite connect as well as he'd have liked because the ball was a bit too full. Kohli gets down on one knee and swipes at the ball. Just enough on it to lob Bravo
threads the gap at extra having moved outside leg again. The old inside out Kohli drive
dropped it. Came right back at Jadeja, he moved well enough to his right but shells a relatively straightfoward chance
shorter and quicker on and around off stump. Kohli was going for a cut, but can't connect
shovel drives a fuller delivery on middle to extra cover. Made room, but couldn't get the gap
flighted on middle, Kohli answers with a straight bat
eased through the covers as he meets the good length ball with an open face
fired in down leg again, DK was going for the pull. Should have connected better, but perhaps the ball keeping a hint low hurt his timing. Only a single to square leg
flatter delivery outside off, punched to short cover
tossed up, but slid down leg. DK has pulled off a powerful sweep. All along the ground and well wide of the man at short fine
short, but lots of turn off the deck. Kohli is a little lead-footed against it as he bunts to long-off
pushed through on middle, sent back at the bowler
fired in on middle, Kohli goes for a short-armed jab into the leg side but Mohit does good work at short midwicket. Good stretch from the fast bowler
touch wider outside off and he drives that wider of long off but only for one now
clever batting, smart running - he eased the length delivery towards long off, not too hard, and called for two early
flighted towards off and Kohli muscles that ball through the covers with a flick of the wrists. Nice cover drive for four
slightly slower towards off, driven past cover for one in the deep
presses forward and blocks the length delivery outside off
fullish on middle and leg, pushed down to long off for one
that's a delicate late cut by opening the face of the bat for four! He didn't have to muscle any power into that shot, only used the pace of the ball by guiding it fine to beat Bravo at third man
punches the ball towards long off, but Baz runs and dives to his right - full length - and saves at  least one. Spectacular effort!
slower and fuller outside off, Kohli mistimes the drive but gets one by pushing it to long on
nipping in slightly from outside off, DK runs it down to third man for one
towards the stumps now and Kohli pushes that down to long on for one
back of length on off, Kohli gets an inside edge onto his pads before the ball goes to cover
on length outside off, DK drives it nicely on off but Baz dives to cut it at shortish cover
that's too short, DK pivots on his back foot and slams the ball behind square on the leg side with a pull. Smith slides to his right to get a hand to it in the deep but it beats him
into the pads, DK flicks and mistimes it to midwicket
slower outside off and he slashes that through the covers to deep point
leans towards the ball on off and tucks the ball to leg for one
chipped back, just wide of Ishwar to his right. Kohli tried to rolls his wrists over the length delivery and managed an inside edge towards mid on
this time he gets an inside edge and it just misses the stumps to go fine and fast down the leg side for four as DK looked to push it on off
short ball outside off, DK mistimes the pull to find midwicket
into the pads and Kohli flicks that beautifully behind square on the leg side. Ishwar runs from fine leg to his left, slides the ball in. Then regains his balance and slides it in again to save one
slightly outside off and punched down towards mid on for one

it's not ABD, but there's a run out and Mandeep is going back without facing a ball! Kohli flicked the length ball to midwicket and called for a very risky single, Mandeep responded too but Negi's flat throw was pretty accurate and Dhoni whipped the bails off in no time
length delivery outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat to guide it to point

full toss straight to mid off, du Plessis does the needful! It was a low full toss around off, ABD drove it towards the covers and straight to mid off! Faf only had to go low to his left, huge wicket for CSK
length delivery just outside off, runs it to slip this time
this time behind square, four more! Got only a bit of width on the off side and he merely tapped it between short third man and slip, right in the gap for four
cuts it in slightly from outside off, ABD stays back and punches to cover
full toss on the stumps now, steered wide of deep midwicket with a flick of the wrists, all along the ground for four
back of length towards off, he goes back to off and tucks the ball to leg for one
no getting away for Nehra this time, AB not missing out on this pitched up delivery as he comes out and clobbers it straight back, Nehra manages to avoid getting hit
short ball, AB has absolutely creamed this pull off the front foot, but picked out midwicket
slightly leg sidish but Kohli does not find timing on the clip, and mid on reaches it to his right
cramps him for room with a pitched up ball on middle, AB tries to force it away, will only get a single to mid off
is shuffling around in the crease, but Nehra does not give away much with a length ball just outside off, and AB pats it quietly
short of a good length, just outside off, Kohli taps it in front of backward point, Jadeja runs in but cannot pick up the ball
hint of away shape on this full delivery outside off, AB jabs it away
leaves the crease this time, takes the length ball and drags it in front of square on the leg side, saw the ball getting slightly big on him, slowed his charge and went squarer, back leg in the air
he's slammed this fullish ball, but hit the drive straight to mid off
lots of width this time, shortish length too, AB does not look to do a lot with it, just makes sure he cuts in the air and clears backward point comfortably
tries to flay this through the off side but it is not full enough and not too wide as well
Maddinson's struggle is over, he's failed to connect for the final time this innings, charges out to a full toss, heaves and misses, the line is right on the stumps, and the off peg is uprooted
has him reaching for a pitched up ball now, and Kohli can only squeeze it weakly to backward point
good length ball on off stump, he moves across and runs it to point
width there for Kohli outside off, and he leans forward to scythe a drive through the covers
straightening on a length on middle, and that line is picked away in front of square
back of a length, tight line around off, pushed to covers off the back foot
good length ball around off stump, defended down the track
shortish, leg side, Pandey gets away with this, Maddinson wanted to swat this square, missed yet again this over
good length ball right on middle stump, Maddinson taps it square on the off side
Maddinson leaves the crease and wants to swing this length ball over midwicket, does not connect once more
leg sidish from Pandey and all Maddinson has to do is get something on it, he does that, and runs it fine past the keeper
has a swish and misses this shortish ball
and he's hit on the pad first ball, there is a big appeal, Pandey getting it to hold the line from a good length, struck him a bit high and he was also getting a big stride out
